home-title: Kinrox — Mac video player with an iPhone remote
home-description: Kinrox is a free, open-source video player for Mac with a companion iPhone remote. MacBook on the projector, you on the couch: pause, skip, scrub and change the volume without getting up.
home-social-title: Kinrox — stop getting up to pause the movie
home-social-description: A minimalist Mac video player with a real iPhone remote. Free and open source.

kinrox-plays-any-video-on-your-mac-and-t: Kinrox plays any video on your Mac — and turns your iPhone into its remote. MacBook on the projector, you on the couch: pause, jump back 10 seconds, turn the volume down or start the next episode without leaving the blanket.
movie-night-shouldn-t-need-a-trip-to-the: Movie night shouldn’t need a trip to the keyboard.
the-mac-is-across-the-room: The Mac is across the room
it-s-plugged-into-the-projector-by-the-w: It’s plugged into the projector by the wall. Every pause means getting up, finding the trackpad in the dark and squinting at a tiny control bar.
kinrox-tap-pause-on-the-phone-in-your-ha: {0}{1}Kinrox: tap pause on the phone in your hand.
whispers-in-one-scene-explosions-in-the-: Whispers in one scene, explosions in the next — and someone is already asleep in the next room.
kinrox-a-volume-slider-right-under-your-: {0}{1}Kinrox: a volume slider right under your thumb.
web-panels-with-ip-addresses-and-passwor: Web panels with IP addresses and passwords, a browser tab that falls asleep, buttons made for a desk — not for a couch.
kinrox-finds-your-mac-by-itself-pairs-wi: {0}{1}Kinrox: finds your Mac by itself, pairs with one code.
a-remote-made-for-a-dark-room: A remote made for a dark room.
big-targets-a-dark-warm-theme-and-a-ligh: Big targets, a dark warm theme and a light tap of haptics under every press. You can use it without looking away from the film.
every-control-is-large-enough-to-hit-hal: Every control is large enough to hit half‑asleep.
missed-a-line-one-tap-back-skip-the-intr: Missed a line? One tap back. Skip the intro with two.
kinrox-s-own-volume-from-0-to-100-the: Kinrox’s own volume, from 0 to 100. The Mac’s system volume stays untouched.

pick-something-you-watched-before-it-ope: Pick something you watched before — it opens on the Mac.
drag-the-timeline-to-any-moment-switch-f: Drag the timeline to any moment, switch fullscreen from the couch.
no-ip-addresses-no-passwords-no-account-: No IP addresses, no passwords, no account. After the first code your iPhone reconnects by itself.
open-a-video-on-your-mac: Open a video on your Mac
drag-a-file-into-kinrox-or-press-o-the: Drag a file into Kinrox or press {0}⌘{1} {2}O{3}. The remote server is on by default.
pick-your-mac-on-the-iphone: Pick your Mac on the iPhone
kinrox-shows-up-on-its-own-when-both-dev: Kinrox shows up on its own when both devices are on the same Wi‑Fi.
the-mac-shows-a-code-that-lives-for-two: The Mac shows a code that lives for two minutes. Three wrong tries and it’s gone.
alex-s-iphone-wants-to-control-kinrox-en: Alex’s iPhone wants to control Kinrox. Enter this code on your phone.
a-player-that-gets-out-of-the-way: A player that gets out of the way.
the-video-is-the-interface-a-thin-layer-: The video is the interface. A thin layer of glass appears when you need it and hides after three seconds.
built-on-libmpv-the-engine-behind-mpv-an: Built on libmpv, the engine behind mpv and IINA. Choose embedded or external audio and subtitles. VideoToolbox handles hardware decoding.
kinrox-lines-up-the-videos-in-the-folder: Kinrox lines up the videos in the folder and starts the next one when an episode ends — “2” before “10”, like Finder.
keyboard-keys-control-center-and-now-pla: Keyboard ⏯ keys, Control Center and Now Playing control Kinrox. Up to 20 recent files wait on the start screen.
what-happens-in-your-living-room-stays-t: What happens in your living room stays there.
your-mac-and-iphone-exchange-playback-co: Your Mac and iPhone exchange playback commands directly over your local network. Your videos stay on the Mac.
discovery-over-bonjour-connections-only-: Discovery over Bonjour, connections only from your own subnet. Public addresses and cellular are refused.
every-command-travels-in-an-encrypted-ch: Every command travels in an encrypted channel. Pairing tokens live in the Keychain on both devices.
no-accounts-or-usage-analytics-the-mac-c: No accounts or usage analytics. The Mac checks a public update feed daily without unique identifiers or system profiling. This website has no analytics or cookies.
your-files-stay-on-the-mac: Your files stay on the Mac
the-remote-sees-titles-and-durations-nev: The remote sees titles and durations, never file paths. Opening a recent file is resolved on the Mac.
free-open-yours-to-read-and-change: Free. Open. Yours to read and change.
kinrox-is-written-in-swift-6-and-swiftui: Kinrox is written in Swift 6 and SwiftUI on top of libmpv. Every line of the player, the remote and the protocol is on GitHub.
playback-and-remote-control-work-without: Playback and remote control work without internet access when the Mac and iPhone share a Wi‑Fi network. The Mac uses HTTPS for daily update checks and downloads an update when you choose to install it.
does-it-work-with-a-tv-not-a-projector: Does it work with a TV, not a projector?
yes-kinrox-plays-on-whatever-your-mac-sh: Yes. Kinrox plays on whatever your Mac shows — a projector, a TV over HDMI, or a display connected with AirPlay.
which-macs-and-iphones-are-supported: Which Macs and iPhones are supported?
macs-with-apple-silicon-on-macos-14-sono: Macs with Apple silicon on macOS 14 Sonoma or later, and iPhones on iOS 17 or later. Intel Macs are not supported yet.
can-more-than-one-iphone-control-the-sam: Can more than one iPhone control the same Mac?
yes-each-iphone-pairs-once-with-its-own-: Yes. Each iPhone pairs once with its own code; up to four remotes can be connected at the same time. You can revoke any of them in the player settings.
can-i-pick-audio-and-subtitle-tracks: Can I pick audio and subtitle tracks?
yes-on-mac-use-the-audio-subtitles-butto: Yes. On Mac, use the Audio & Subtitles button or the Audio and Subtitles menus. Choose embedded tracks, find external files in nested folders, or turn subtitles off. Kinrox can remember your choice for the next episode.
nothing-kinrox-is-free-and-open-source-u: Nothing. Kinrox is free and open source under the GNU GPL v3.
kinrox-for-mac-and-iphone-free-open-sour: Kinrox for Mac and iPhone. Free, open source, and made for movie nights.
free-software-under-gpl-3-0-not-affiliat: Free software under GPL‑3.0. Not affiliated with Apple.
a-person-lies-on-a-couch-under-a-blanket: A person lies on a couch under a blanket holding an iPhone. Behind them, a MacBook and a projector play a film on the wall.

support-description: Connect Kinrox Remote on iPhone to the Kinrox video player on Mac.
kinrox-remote-controls-the-kinrox-video-: Kinrox Remote controls the Kinrox video player on a Mac. It requires iOS 17 or later and a compatible Mac running Kinrox. Both devices must be on the same local network. The iPhone app does not play or stream videos.
get-the-mac-player-from-the-official-rel: Get the Mac player from the {0}official releases{1} and launch it.
enable-remote-control-in-kinrox-on-the-m: Enable remote control in Kinrox on the Mac, then open Connect iPhone to display a pairing code.
connect-the-iphone-to-the-same-local-net: Connect the iPhone to the same local network and allow Local Network access for both apps when prompted.
select-the-mac-in-kinrox-remote-and-ente: Select the Mac in Kinrox Remote and enter the six-digit code shown on the Mac. Use a fresh code if it has expired.
open-a-local-video-on-the-mac-use-your: Open a local video on the Mac. Use your iPhone to pause, seek, adjust volume or open available recent files.
check-that-kinrox-is-running-and-remote-: Check that Kinrox is running and remote control is enabled. Check Local Network permissions on both devices. Guest Wi-Fi, client isolation, VPNs and firewall settings can prevent devices from discovering each other. Try the same normal home network and keep both apps in the foreground while pairing.
try-the-controls-without-a-mac: Try the controls without a Mac
open-settings-in-kinrox-remote-and-choos: Open Settings in Kinrox Remote and choose Try Demo without Mac. The demo uses fictional media and does not connect to or control a real Mac. Exit the demo in Settings when you are ready to pair.
if-pairing-has-been-revoked-on-the-mac-p: If pairing has been revoked on the Mac, pair again using a fresh code. A recent file must still be available on the Mac; moved or deleted files cannot be opened from the remote. Next and Previous follow video files in the current Mac folder.
report-an-issue-or-ask-for-help-include-: {0}Report an issue or ask for help{1}. Include your iOS and macOS versions, Kinrox versions, what you tried and the error message. Do not include pairing tokens, private filenames or other sensitive information. GitHub issues are public.
privacy-description: How Kinrox handles local playback and remote pairing data.
effective-when-this-page-is-published-up: Effective when this page is published. Updated October 30, 2026.
kinrox-is-a-local-video-player-for-mac-a: Kinrox is a local video player for Mac and a companion remote for iPhone. The apps do not send personal data, playback history or usage analytics to the developer. There are no accounts, advertising SDKs or cloud services in the apps.
the-mac-player-stores-recent-file-bookma: The Mac player stores recent-file bookmarks and preferences on your Mac. The iPhone remote stores a random device identifier, the selected Mac and connection preferences on your iPhone. Pairing credentials are stored in each device’s Keychain. The remote receives playback state and recent-file titles and durations from your Mac. Full file-system paths and video files are not transmitted to the iPhone.
with-your-permission-kinrox-discovers-pl: With your permission, Kinrox discovers players using Bonjour and exchanges control commands and playback information over your local network. Paired sessions use encryption. Device and service names are visible during local network discovery; discovery itself is not an encrypted channel. The apps do not use a developer-operated relay server.
starting-with-version-0-3-0-the-mac-play: Starting with version 0.3.0, the Mac player uses Sparkle to read the public update feed on GitHub Pages once a day and when you choose Check for Updates. Checks do not include unique device identifiers, playback history, or a system profile. When you choose to install an update, Sparkle downloads the signed installer from GitHub Releases. GitHub may process request information such as IP addresses under its privacy policy. Playback and iPhone remote control do not require internet access.
pairing-credentials-remain-until-you-rem: Pairing credentials remain until you remove them. Use Forget in the iPhone app’s settings to remove that Mac’s saved credentials from the iPhone. Revoke the iPhone in the Mac player’s remote settings to remove its access on the Mac. These are separate actions; forgetting on the iPhone does not revoke the Mac’s record. You can clear the recent-files list in the Mac player. You can disable Local Network access in system settings. Keychain entries may survive uninstalling an app, so use the pairing controls before uninstalling if you want to remove saved credentials.
if-you-choose-to-contact-us-through-gith: If you choose to contact us through {0}GitHub Issues{1}, the information you submit is handled by GitHub under its privacy policy and may be public. Do not post pairing tokens, private filenames or other sensitive information. This website is hosted on GitHub Pages; the hosting provider may process request information such as IP addresses under {2}GitHub’s Privacy Statement{3}. Kinrox adds no analytics scripts or cookies.
for-privacy-questions-contact-the-mainta: For privacy questions, contact the maintainer through the {0}Kinrox issue tracker{1}. We will update this page when the apps’ data handling changes.
